ALTER PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERTELEPHONENUMBER_CCD
AS
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber AS 
(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY INSERT_DTTM DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Landline Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA,BCD.CUST_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Mobile Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
) MONTHLY

UNION 

SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Landline Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA,BCD.CUST_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_PHONE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1

UNION 

SELECT
     BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,'Mobile Number' AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,CONCAT(BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_PHONE) AS TelephoneNumber
    ,BCD.CUST_TIME_MAINT AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_AREA AS AreaCode
    ,BCD.CUST_MOBILE_CTY AS CountryCode
    ,BCDD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCD.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BCD.BNK_CODE
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER_DELTA BCDD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD ON BCD.CUST_NBR = BCDD.CUST_NBR  AND BCD.ISLATEST = 1
) DAILY
)A
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,AreaCode
,CountryCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,TelephoneNumber
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,AreaCode
,CountryCode
)) HASHROW, CustomerId
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD'	 AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	--,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerStatusTypeId,TGT.CustomerStatusTypeId) AS CustomerStatusTypeId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA FROM TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

------UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ')
FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber TGT
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL;


---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber  ( 
    CustomerId
    ,TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,TelephoneNumber
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,PreferenceId
    ,TelephoneNumberNote
    ,LocationId
    ,TextCapableIndicator
    ,ExtensionNumber
    ,DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,DateOfRequest
    ,AreaCode
    ,CountryCode
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
    SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
    ,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ') AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId
    ,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
    ,NULL AS LocationId
    ,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
    ,AreaCode AS AreaCode
    ,CountryCode AS CountryCode
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber SRC
JOIN #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId



------INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber
(
    CustomerId
    ,TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,TelephoneNumber
    ,PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,PreferenceId
    ,TelephoneNumberNote
    ,LocationId
    ,TextCapableIndicator
    ,ExtensionNumber
    ,DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,DateOfRequest
    ,AreaCode
    ,CountryCode
    ,SourceCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,WorkFlowId
    ,TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm
)
SELECT
    CustomerId AS CustomerId
    ,TelephoneNumberTypeId AS TelephoneNumberTypeId
    ,TelephoneNumber AS TelephoneNumber
    ,STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(PeriodStartTimestamp,13,0,':'),11,0,':'),9,0,' ') AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,NULL AS PreferenceId
    ,NULL AS TelephoneNumberNote
    ,NULL AS LocationId
    ,NULL AS TextCapableIndicator
    ,NULL AS ExtensionNumber
    ,NULL AS DoNotDisturbIndicator
    ,NULL AS DateOfRequest
    ,AreaCode AS AreaCode
    ,CountryCode AS CountryCode
    ,'CCD' AS SourceCode
    ,BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber;
DROP TABLE #TMP_BNKM_CustomerTelephoneNumber_DELTA;

END
